segments.name: Retail services
segments.description: Operates and franchises retail service centers in the U.S. and Canada, selling quick oil changes and preventive maintenance to consumers and fleet customers.
segments.evidence: Valvoline operates and franchises approximately 2,200 service center locations through its VIOC and GCOC retail locations and supports over 240 locations through its Express Care platform.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and commercial fleet customers pay for oil changes and other preventive maintenance at company-operated stores, while franchisees pay royalties and other fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Net revenues are limited to sales at company-operated stores, in addition to royalties and other fees from independent franchised and Express Care stores.

changes.text: In 2023 Valvoline sold its former Global Products reportable segment, now doing business as Valvoline Global Operations.
changes.evidence: On March 1, 2023, Valvoline completed the sale of its former Global Products reportable segment ("Global Products"), now doing business as Valvoline Global Operations ("VGO") to Aramco Overseas Company B.V.
